notes.title: HumanitZ Hotfix .917.H1
notes.notes:
Dear, Survivors

We’re aware of the ongoing issues with vehicles—specifically players hoarding large numbers of them, and others using them for PvP actions on PvE servers. This week’s hotfix begins addressing that.

While the full vehicle respawn system will be introduced in our next major update (918) aswell as address sky bases, it wasn’t ready in time for this patch. In the meantime, server admins will be monitoring activity, especially for excessive vehicle hoarding.

This hotfix also includes several other improvements and fixes—please read the full patch notes below for all the details.

Server Info: Server owners please restart to pull latest patch (new vehicle claim system can be disabled on community servers via gameserversetting.ini file by changing MaxOwnedCars=0 )


🚗 Vehicle Claiming System (New!)
We've added a new vehicle claiming system—a long-requested feature to improve fairness and reduce vehicle-related frustration on both PvE and PvP servers.

Key Details:


 This is a server setting and can be enabled or disabled by server owners.
 Players can now claim up to 2 vehicles on official servers. (trial period feedback welcome)
 In PvE, other players cannot access your claimed vehicle, unless they are in your clan.
 Claimed vehicles cannot be damaged by other players in PvE.
 All vehicle parts must be installed before a vehicle can be claimed.
 Once claimed, the built-in padlock system activates, allowing you to lock your vehicle.
 You can unclaim a vehicle at any time if you want to switch to another one.
 This system is designed to give players a fairer experience and cut down on vehicle hoarding or griefing. (See images below for a preview of how it works in-game.)


Claim your vehicle by adding all parts and clicking the CLAIM button
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/52df8419c1525fb107bc3868379e4b36ed89c822.png

To unclaim a vehicle just click the UNCLAIM button but remember to take your parts out ;)

Hey Survivors! Update .917 has arrived! 

Giddy up, Survivors — Horses Are Here! 

That’s right, the apocalypse just got a whole lot wilder. Now you can ride into danger (or away from it) on horseback — perfect for when that precious fuel runs dry.

Update 917 is here, and it's easily one of the biggest updates we've ever dropped. We're talking new content, fresh mechanics, updated map design, vehicles, weapons, crafting systems, base building upgrades, and so much more.

This patch is packed, so be sure to take your time going through the full list of additions and changes below.

To all our Survivors — thank you for the continued support. You’re the reason we keep building, creating, and surviving together.

Let’s ride. Let’s build. Let’s survive. LET’S GOOOO!

HumanitZ is also on Sale during our Indie.io Publisher sale!!! Great time to dive in!!
https://bit.ly/indieio_PubSale2025


Localization: We have added improvements to Spanish and German localizations, please give us feedback and report any issues you find. Thank you to our community for the support and help with these.

Server Info: Official Servers will be wiped due to the extensive changes to the map. All Server owners will need to update their servers in order to reap the benefits of the big changes, including the newly added RCON system to allow remote communication and restarts.

Hey Survivors! Update .916 is Here! 

After an incredible few weeks of experimental testing, we’re thrilled to bring you the .916 update! A massive shoutout to our amazing community—your feedback and dedication have helped us craft an update that makes the game better than ever.

We’re incredibly proud of this update, as we truly believe the game has never looked this good! We’ve tackled the texture and blurriness issues reported by players, resulting in a sharper, more polished visual experience.

But that’s not all! One of the most requested features since early access is finally here—the new fixed camera option. No more relying on Q&E or the middle mouse button to rotate—now the fixed camera automatically follows your crosshair, making gameplay smoother and more intuitive.
This update also brings tons of new features, additions, fixes, and quality-of-life improvements, all designed to enhance your experience.

notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

Spooky season is finally upon us and we are back with another BIG update, adding some Halloween event flavour! In the 0.913 patch notes, you'll not only see Halloween-themed content, but a big list of changes and new features added to the game.

While the game evolves, some things get shifted in priority -almost daily. Rather than add new quests and extending the localization timeframe, we opted to focus primarily on the localization up to and including this update. [previewyoutube=mjneBIxzGmc;full][/previewyoutube]

The hurdles we are facing right now are depending on what settings you're playing on. The device can become warm and in certain high density areas, there are still minor lag spikes, and in some cases, shutting down the device. We are moving closer to our goal of being fully supported and we plan to complete this before the end of the year.

Localization: There has been a complete overhaul for Chinese localization! This has been completed with help from our publishers, so our Chinese community can now enjoy the game with a brand new and improved localization update.

Other languages are still ongoing with amazing help from our awesome community. It is a big undertaking, so if you would like to help us get there, please reach out in the Official HumanitZ Discord. notes.title: Patch #1 Dev Build 0.901
notes.notes:
Survivors, 

Our first post-release patch is here, and we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you. Your dedication and valuable feedback have spurred us to work tirelessly on enhancing your post-apocalyptic experience. 

Here’s a comprehensive breakdown of what this patch brings. 

Gameplay Enhancements

Map Improvements: We’ve added more resources, including additional bushes, stones and interactive fire barrels to keep you warm during the unforgiving winter season.
Additional World Creation Options: Customize your survival adventure with more options! Adjust zeek multipliers, explore perma-death settings (Individual - If MP you must keep the host alive, All - one dies we all die), and choose to remove infection on death. 
 Vitals Settings: Tailor your gameplay with vital settings; offering slower, normal, and faster rates of hunger, thirst, and infection drain.


User Interface & Experience

Gamepad-Friendly: Enjoy a smoother gaming experience with improved gamepad UI and tooltips.
Human AI Mechanics: Our survivors are getting smarter! We've added new human AI mechanics for a more dynamic world.
Inventory Improvements: Managing your gear just got easier. We’ve made it easier to change location when you have multiple pistols and tools. We’ve also made improvements to quick slots. (Now easier to change when adding binoculars or compass etc).
Tooltip Enhancements: Get a clearer understanding of debuff icons with tooltips on mouseovers.
Rotation Options: Discover a new "Auto" rotate option for player rotation in gameplay settings. Adjust Rotation Sensitivity to find your sweet spot.
New Map Markers: Navigate your world more efficiently with fresh map marker icons.


Survival Challenges:

Prolonged Water Purification: It now takes longer to clean water at a cooking location.
Fire Fix: Fires will now go out properly, preventing interactions after they're extinguished.


Bug Fixes & Gameplay Tweaks:

Quality of Life: Enjoy an array of quality-of-life improvements. We’ve improved loot, movement and interaction with Trader. We’ve also improved the loot of the Survivor Car.
Helmet Surprises: Armored zeeks now have a chance of losing their helmets, creating headshot opportunities.
Build Actor Insights: Keep track of build actor health when you're near them.
Stealthy Steps: We've slightly reduced player footstep sound to attract fewer zeeks.
Roaming Horde Nerf: The Roaming Horde has been adjusted to introduce special zeek types more slowly to the horde.
Extra Storage:  We've added an extra row of 5 slots to crafted storage containers.
UI Fixes: Bid farewell to issues like hypothermia UI being stuck on screen after respawn. 
Zeek Gridlock: Zeeks are back to navigating with the grace of undead creatures. Dead zeeks will no longer prevent other zeeks from navigating properly.
Weather Woes: We've addressed weather-related bugs, including the infamous spring blizzard issue. Snow may show on loaded save but will clear after time in game. 
Container Convenience: Swap items effortlessly using the middle mouse button within containers.
Inventory Bug Fixes Including: Say goodbye to problems like the disappearing bike helmet when inventory is full, and players getting stuck in the backpack animation. 
Lock-Picking Freedom: Fixed getting stuck in the lock picking animation. You can also now exit the lock picking system by hitting ESC. 
Blueprint Fixes: You can now vault through blueprints like, unfinished window barricades.
Zeek Horde Tweaks: Zeek hordes have undergone improvements and fixes. 


Last but not least we have a potential fix for interaction issues on respawn. 

Survivors, while we're still diligently crafting our roadmap to 1.0, this patch is our way of quickly responding to your invaluable feedback. The apocalypse continues, and your resilience inspires us. Continue to share your thoughts on our Discord and Steam reviews. 

Keep surviving, 
HumanitZ Team🧟🔥💥

notes.title: May Dev Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to our 3rd developer’s log!

It’s been a while since our last update. We move ever so close to early access so we wanted to share what we’ve been working on with our community! 


Custom Character Creation 


One feature we’ve been working hard on is custom character creation. From this menu, you can make adjustments to your character’s face, skin, facial hair, and hairstyle, as well as what clothing they wear. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/4ed42e429bce79cc523a5bca884414192a0f3e62.png


As a bonus, better clothing and equipment can be found in game to upgrade your character! You can equip those via the inventory menu.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/5cb5e849cc11fb4ef5f3e874f2829a0caf34469e.png


Vehicle Parts


Now, you can no longer jump into a car and just drive off into the sunset! 😉 You must check to ensure the vehicle has all its required parts such as the battery, starter motor, fuel pump, and fan belt.


These parts can be scavenged from other vehicles in the world!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/ad08f43391191f1f1d943931b7e3d5e8ab1a3f62.png


Don’t forget - parts can lose durability over time, just like in the real world. Driving and wear and tear will cut through that durability! Once one of the parts reached 0% durability, the car will stop running.


Here’s what parts might look like:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/bbd8c5a69a1b2c869486adc7be9558e5bf99e3ac.png


Skill System


We’ve added a skill system to the game players can now gain xp from doing a number of things in the game.


XP helps you level up and you are rewarded with a skill point for every level that you can spend to help improve and progress your character.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/98646bece2fda510377f57e739167435d3d9cccb.png


Mobile Base


We’ve now added a “mobile base”: The RV! Not only does it have great storage space, it allows you to cook while travelling around the apocalypse. Score!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/87d55a4276f79cf5756e307cd7435df5173836d4.png


CB Trader


We’ve added the option to be able to craft a CB radio which players can use to attempt to call in traders to their location.


These traders can be killed by zombies so make sure it’s safe before calling them.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/9feb8a8632834456700cf4f73bac7daf44089991.png

Farming and Crops

You can now speed up the growing of crops by using fertilizer.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/335d34b173a15180befff9aa0ec5090d303b5db4.png


We have also added tomatoes and cabbage as new items to grow.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/60f536262172ae668d294c9fc8fa9c1f57e172ad.png


Other updates/Changes

 We fixed huge inventory lag issues, which boosts performance.
 Zombie AI has been improved!

 You can scroll with mouse wheel to zoom in and out slightly with your character
 Improved vehicle UI, for interaction, repairing and fueling and when driving.
 Crafting system has been tweaked, so crafted items are now stored inside the actor.
 3D preview of character in the inventory
 Slowly swapping out the old UI for the new UI
 Working on controller support
 Overhaul of the new large map



Our team has been working super hard to bring us a better game, and we couldn’t appreciate your support more! If you’d like to give us feedback and be part of our community, don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on Twitter, YouTube, and Facebook! Thank you for checking out our developer’s log and thanks to everyone that is hyped and supporting us. It really means a lot. Don’t forget to wishlist!

https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxbK8zIFCFvQ67q6g9Yw_KkasOM1sYCThJ

Thank you for checking out our developer’s log and thanks to everyone that is hyped and supporting us. It really means a lot. Don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!

notes.title: September Dev Update
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors
 
Today we update you with everything going on with all things HumanitZ.
 
Originally the game was due to be ready around September/October of 2022 but in June we made a huge move to rebuild a number of major systems... From scratch!!
 
- Recreation of vitals and damage system
- Brand new shooting ballistics system
- New animation system
- New Grapple System
- New combat system including root motion animation
- Improved interaction and pickup system

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284373/fca836329738c8893d6e00047a85eafad04b7515.jpg
 
Making all these changes has created a lot more work for our small team and naturally pushed the release date to later than expected. And of course with making these major changes it creates more issues and extra bugs so it’s been a busy few months for us all.
 
So.. the big part... HumanitZ will now release end of Q1 2023, the reason for the extended delay is due to the rebuilding of major systems and also we are having custom modular characters and brand new UI created for our game which we will share some sneak peeks of soon. So lots of big changes happening but all for the good of the game.
 
I know this isn’t the news some of you wanted but we'd rather you be angry at the game being delayed than be angry that the game was rushed and not ready.
 
Thanks to everyone single one of you that supports us and that is excited for HumanitZ. If you haven't already, you should join our Discord and follow us on Twitter. 
 
Kind Regards
Yoz
